definitions.explanation: Describes being extremely tired or fatigued, completely drained of energy.
Describes something that has become soft and limp, like overcooked vegetables.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧くたくた⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{疲|つか}れた→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧。
⟦マラソン→マラソン：04732_marason⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧くたくた⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: My body is worn out after the marathon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一日中|いちにちじゅう}→一日中：09519_ichinichijuu⟧⟦{歩|ある}いて→歩く：00538_aruku⟧、くたくた⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}った→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: I walked all day and came home completely exhausted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧くたくた⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{煮|に}る→煮る：01971_niru⟧。
examples.english: To cook vegetables until soft and limp.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧くたくた⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{煮込|にこ}んだ→煮込む：05822_nikomu⟧。
examples.english: I simmered the daikon until it was completely soft.

examples.japanese: ⟦ほうれん{草|そう}→ほうれん草：05188_hourensou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧くたくた⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{茹|ゆ}でてしまった→茹でる：02324_yuderu⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{食感|しょっかん}→食感：06636_shokkan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なくなった→なくなる：01101_nakunaru⟧。
examples.english: I boiled the spinach until it went limp, so it lost its texture.

notes:
くたくた is a ⟦{擬態語|ぎたいご}→擬態語：22468_gitaigo⟧ (mimetic word) with two related meanings: exhaustion and limpness/softness from overcooking.

MEANING 1 — EXHAUSTION:
- くたくた⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{疲|つか}れる→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧: to be completely exhausted
- くたくた⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become worn out
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧くたくた⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧: I'm dead tired from work

MEANING 2 — OVERCOOKED/LIMP:
- くたくた⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{煮|に}る→煮る：01971_niru⟧: to simmer until very soft
- ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧くたくた⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{煮込|にこ}む→煮込む：05822_nikomu⟧: to stew vegetables until they're soft

SIMILAR WORDS (exhaustion):
- ⟦へとへと→へとへと：05273_hetoheto⟧: exhausted (emphasizes physical fatigue)
- ⟦ぐったり→ぐったり：05835_guttari⟧: limp, drained (more complete collapse)
- ⟦ぐだぐだ→ぐだぐだ：09297_gudaguda⟧: sluggish, sloppy (less about tiredness, more about being unmotivated)
- ⟦くたびれる→くたびれる：noentry⟧: to be tired, worn out (verb form, slightly literary)
